title: Belo Horizonte: official note gives scope, about 250 taxpayers and refunds
what_changed: The city's official note (updated 19 November) says the attack altered some slips issued from early 14 to the morning of 16 November so Pix payments did not reach the city, that it affected about 250 taxpayers, and that banks blocked the money with refunds starting 17 November. Summary and sources updated; validation now corroborated with the city's own page.
